title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
summary: Mark Wahlberg is launching an affordable gym concept offering longevity services like cold plunges and blood panels without premium pricing, entering a market dominated by high-cost wellness startups.
content: Mark Wahlberg, who once sank money into a gym chain that got kicked off the NYSE, is now building his own, and he promises you’ll get a cold plunge, a blood panel and a protein muffin without needing a trust fund.

zh.title: 马克·沃尔伯格想用平价健身房概念挑战长寿初创市场
zh.summary: 马克·沃尔伯格推出了一个平价健身房概念，提供冷水浸泡和血液检测等长寿服务，但不收取高端溢价，进入由高成本健康创业公司主导的市场。
